features.behavior: Line comments, resolvable conversations and review requests
features.progressNote: Thread grouping, thread roots, who may resolve, pending-review reply visibility, review cards, the review form, dismissal display and review request limits/refusals run in rbit-collaboration. Line anchoring (diff hunk excerpts), pending-review routing and request access lookups remain in rbit-services.

features.behavior: Threaded notifications, unsubscribe and daily/weekly digests

Management, payloads, queueing/hook selection, the worker, the HTTP client and the outbound address guard remain legacy.

plannedStateDefinitions.planned: New scope absent from main; its plan is recorded, and preparation may be incomplete.
plannedStateDefinitions.in-progress: Implementation and partial acceptance are underway; the complete product remains unverified.
plannedStateDefinitions.implemented: Complete target-crate implementation and per-delivery-phase acceptance references are recorded and require inspection.

plannedAdditions.behavior: Repository documentation: platform-native localized responsive UI; versioned pages/history/diff/restore/rename; link integrity/search/navigation/media; inherited ACL/archive and recoverable lifecycle/backup integration
plannedAdditions.progress: Wiki tab, page/sidebar/index/title search, history with authors, revision view, compare, and create/edit/rename/restore/delete with per-page conflict detection and a server-rendered preview publish through one rechecking SQL transaction over prepared immutable objects; permissions follow repository access (anonymous public reads, writers change, administrators turn the wiki on/off, archived read-only). Lifecycle: deletion keeps history as a tombstone that writers restore, renames leave aliases redirecting (308, no-store) to the current path and reclaimable by new pages, wikis follow repository transfer and are removed with repository deletion (subscriber plus start-up sweep), and backups (format 6) copy and re-hash the objects the snapshot's revisions reach and verify them on restore. Not done: content search, media, link integrity, table of contents, HTMX enhancements, request-token replay, Git clone/push ingress, managed-writer recovery integration, measured budgets, translations of the newest text beyond English and browser accessibility acceptance.
delivery: W5 measured acceptance and ordinary-flow dogfooding
